title: Optional isolation: oracle diagnostic distinguishes separation, identity, mix-back and deadline failures
description: Optional enhancement track: preserve the existing cafe-first core demo and all existing Fable tasks/defaults. No live pipeline, registry, server, shared BENCHMARKS/MODELS/PLAN/STORY/config edits. New code is offline eval only. Private audio/weights/results stay gitignored. No mic, automatic GPU allocation/cancel, purchase, dependency mutation, uncertain-output self-training, or production adoption. Use hearing-stack and immutable input/profile/config revision. Respect swarm-lock and core rehearsal; stop if experiments compete with it. Commit scope only, run verify_fast, report limitations and notes_for_reviewer. Implement a standalone offline diagnostic CLI and deterministic tests. On existing labelled two-stem mixtures, retain both real MossFormer2 outputs; use clean target to pick the oracle candidate for evaluation only; compare oracle vs actual ECAPA/LDA choice vs selected/overlap-added estimate vs existing mixer/AGC final. Include target-only and target-absent metrics without SI-SDR against zero. Support quiet target ratios 0,-5,-10,-15 dB, both target roles, held-out utterance split, and synthetic/fake-model dry-run. Record per-window compute, configured hop, choice/margin/floor and counts of skipped/raw-fallback windows when replaying the live wrapper. Reuse existing scorers and fixtures; do not create a second general scene generator. Report missing real stems/profiles explicitly; do not label fake output as measured separation. Real-weight run only when already provisioned and spare compute permits it. 40 minute implementation/setup cap; missing data or compute becomes a blocker. User follow-up: explicitly diagnose why embeddings have not reliably worked. Test target loss before selection, ECAPA crop duration/contamination, profile-vs-demo-mic mismatch, negative-profile rejection at cosine>.7, missing-camera strict pause decisions, and mixer/AGC/deadline fallback independently. Report which mechanism is demonstrated, ruled out or still unknown, and the measured intervention that could make it work; do not equate no wrong-voice output with preserved target words. Confirmed human correction: the actual principal case is Aryan/Joseph or two male speakers with distinct voices, including equal/unequal levels, quieter selected voice, both target roles and swapped positions. Male/female is historical comparison only, not the deliverable. In T-200 log same_bucket and profile_negative/readiness/active tier; current saved negative profiles bypass the gender guard, so do not assume it caused every failure. Include T-069 male/male actual-versus-candidate ceiling gap in diagnosis.
acceptance: Dry-run correctly classifies constructed separator-missing-target, wrong-selector, mix-back-leak and missed-deadline cases. CLI manifest and table distinguish oracle from deployable results and show metric denominators/sample rates. Real results or an exact missing-input blocker, with no fabricated metrics. verify_fast passes.
